section_actions.declining_page: Open each page's top query in a live search and check URL Inspection. Position drops: refresh the content and internal links. Stable position with fewer impressions: demand fell, monitor rather than rewrite.
section_actions.ctr_opportunity: Rewrite title tag and meta description. Test question-format title.
section_actions.rising_query: Strengthen the ranking page for these queries (section, FAQ, internal links) or create a dedicated page to accelerate.
section_actions.cannibalization: Pick one canonical URL per query, merge the overlapping content into it, and 301-redirect or de-optimize the others after checking they serve the same intent.
section_actions.page1_opportunity: Expand the ranking page for the query (comparison table, fresher content, updated date in title) and add internal links from strong pages.

finding_actions.declining_page:position_drop: Check {page} for recent edits, indexing or canonical changes; refresh content for "{query}".
finding_actions.declining_page:impressions_drop: Position held but impressions fell on {page}; likely lower demand. Monitor; no on-page fix indicated by the data.
finding_actions.declining_page:ctr_drop: CTR fell at a similar position on {page}; look at the live result for "{query}" and refresh the title and description.
finding_actions.declining_page:absent: {page} has no impressions this period; check URL Inspection for indexing, redirect or removal.
finding_actions.declining_page:unexplained: No single metric explains the drop on {page}; inspect manually.
finding_actions.ctr_opportunity: Rewrite the title and meta description for "{query}" (ranks {position}, CTR {gap} vs. benchmark).
finding_actions.rising_query: Build on momentum for "{query}": strengthen the ranking page or create a dedicated page.
finding_actions.cannibalization: Consolidate "{query}" onto {page}; merge or redirect the competing URLs after an intent check.
finding_actions.page1_opportunity: Push "{query}" from position {position} onto page 1: expand {page} and add internal links.
